gloss: one or the other; either; whichever

definitions.gloss: one or the other; either; whichever
definitions.explanation: A formal pronoun used to select one item from a set of options, meaning 'one of' or 'either one.' More literary than どれか or どちらか, and commonly found in written documents and official instructions.

examples.japanese: いずれかの{方法|ほうほう}で{申|もう}し{込|こ}んでください。
examples.english: Please apply using one of the methods.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}にはいずれかの{条件|じょうけん}を{満|み}たす{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to meet one or the other of the conditions for this problem.

notes:
A formal pronoun meaning "one of" or "either one" from a set of options. More literary and formal than どれか or どちらか. Often used in written documents, contracts, and official instructions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いずれかの + noun: one of the ~
- いずれかを{選|えら}ぶ: to choose one or the other
- いずれかに{該当|がいとう}する: to fall under one of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どれか — which one (casual, general)
- どちらか — one of two (polite but less formal than いずれか)
- いずれも — all of them; every one (contrasts with いずれか which selects one)
